name: Operation Downpour Simulation
description: In a corner of the Court of Fontaine, Turenna and Enghiene, members of the Special Security and Surveillance Patrol, have set up a new tabletop wargame. The stage is set for you to show off your tactical brilliance...

steps.description: Talk to the members of the Maison Gardiennage

dialogs.content: #Just as we set our strategy and picked our script, the Proto-Boss, {NICKNAME}, makes a grand entrance!
Seriously? You believe in that old saying?
"Sensing the heat of impending battle, the Proto-Boss will appear like a bullet from the dark — to commandeer their troops with ruthless efficiency..."
Seems like I showed up right on cue.
I see! You mean to say that the velocity of our musket rounds can still be improved... I feel the same way.
#Put a sock in it, Turenna! We got {NICKNAME} to come all this way, so let's get down to business!
Fair enough. Musket talk comes later, then. Now, Proto-Boss, I'm sure you're in top form, ready to lead your troops at any time, right?
Is this about a new tabletop wargame?
Right you are! The rules and layout have been updated according to scenarios faced by the Special Security and Surveillance Patrol.
Which is to say that this current iteration is more challenging. We've prepared a number of special scenarios, including some contributions from the Patrol's elites.
Some scenarios are seriously brain-boggling... So why don't you lead us by example, Proto-Boss?
Of course, you'll be handsomely compensated for your help. Go play, get paid — two birds with one stone!
Time to strut my stuff, then!
#Just you watch, Turenna. No matter how good {NICKNAME} is, I'm sure the third Assault Scenario will be a real toughie...
#Nonsense! There's no way {M#he'll}{F#she'll} get stuck on that. Maybe you're just getting rusty, Drillmaster.
T—Turenna! The cheek of you!
Let's bet on it, Drillmaster! I wager... Some of Captain Chevreuse's limited-edition ammunition!
Getting paid to play? That's the dream.
Umm, I don't quite get it...
Simply put, after we returned from that cooperative wargame in Liyue, we adapted it to suit the Special Patrol's current needs.
More like lightning than a bullet, no?
